description: Free, no key, nothing stored. Check a Swiss UID (CHE-123.456.788): prefix, nine digits and the modulo 11 check digit. Formal only: the UID and VAT registers are not asked, so it never says whether the business exists or is registered for VAT.

uid.description: the UID, as CHE-123.456.788 or CHE123456788, optionally with MWST/TVA/IVA

name: uid_check
